Technology demonstration for deorbiting.
Description

Technology demonstration for deorbiting. Passed built-in-tests (BIT) on both its primary and redundant Smart Energetics Architecture (SEA) sequencing system and devices and fired Modular Architecture Propulsion System (MAPS) rocket motors.

Results

Terran Orbital's PACSCISAT, built for Pacific Scientific Energetic Materials Company, has successfully demonstrated the reliability and precision of PacSci EMC’s satellite products in space. This self-funded mission provided crucial flight heritage, ensuring confidence in their electronic controllers and propulsion systems.
